reason_summary: Prompt asked the Governed Grants Agent to write the grant application, run a grants-management platform, and disburse award funds. KYE governs WHETHER a grants action may proceed and proves the basis — it does NOT author applications, operate a grants-management platform, or move money; those are §0.30 competing systems.
remediation_hint: Re-scope to the bounded governance act only: admit → decide (§12) → record disposition (§21) → seal Evidence Pack™ (§13) → hold AWARD/DISBURSEMENT/CLAWBACK advisory until §36 two-person sign-off. Application authoring, the grants-management platform, and money movement stay the customer's systems; KYE binds the kye:framework:uniform-guidance-2cfr200 deep map (2 CFR 200, Uniform Guidance) and proves the basis.
